candidate.title: Embed layout references standalone embed assets that are not added to assets.precompile, breaking production
reports: app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:5 references the embed stylesheet without adding it to the rails asset precompile list, potentially causing assetnotprecompiled or a missing stylesheet in production

[medium/bug] app/assets/javascripts/embed.js + app/assets/stylesheets/embed.css.scss — new standalone bundles are never registered in config.assets.precompile (no asset config changes anywhere in the diff); rails only precompiles registered non-default bundles, so production will 404 the embed script and the iframe stylesheet

new embed asset manifests (embed.css.scss, embed.js) are never registered in config.assets.precompile — the embed layout references stylesheetlinktag 'embed' but under rails 4/sprockets-rails 2 production defaults every /embed/best request would 500, and embed.js has no route, precompile entry, or stable url for external consumption

[advisory] the embed layout loads stylesheetlinktag 'embed' but nothing in the diff adds embed.css (or embed.js) to the asset precompile list rails requires for non-manifest assets. in production the compiled embed page requests /assets/embed-.css and gets a 404, so every embedded comment widget renders unstyled — a failure invisible in development where all assets are served on demand.
